item.text: The failures point to two independent bugs: slugification is treating each punctuation/space character separately and dropping accents instead of folding them; truncation misses a separator exactly at the length boundary. I’m checking the written spec against the edge cases before patching both implementations.

The code changes are in place. The repository’s README command uses `python`, which isn’t installed in this environment, so I’m using `python3` for the documented unittest run and will also rerun pytest.

item.text:
Fixed the failing slugkit tests.

Changes:
- Added Unicode accent folding via `unicodedata`.
- Collapsed punctuation/whitespace runs into one separator.
- Corrected truncation when a separator falls exactly at `max_len`.

Validation:

- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v` — 16 passed
- `pytest -q` — 16 passed
- `git diff --check` — clean
